language.title: Interface Language
language.desc: Select your preferred language for the ALTERA application. Preference is saved locally in your browser.

templates.description: Save reusable task and project setups locally. Templates do not copy history, sessions or linked records.

storage.title: IndexedDB Storage Engine
storage.desc: ALTERA runs strictly client-side. All project definitions, task checklists, work sessions, knowledge notes, reference resources, attachments, and activity audit logs are kept in your browser's local IndexedDB engine.

backup.title: Workspace Backup & Restore
backup.desc: Export all workspace records, including binary file attachments, into a portable JSON file, or restore from a previous backup.
backup.importConfirmDesc: Restoring from backup will replace records in your local IndexedDB datastore. Tables detected: {{count}}.
backup.importRecoveryPolicy: Portable workspace preferences and reminder timing will be restored. Language, dismissed reminders, and note recovery drafts stay on this device and are not included or cleared.
backup.importSuccess: Workspace restored successfully ({{projects}} projects, {{tasks}} tasks, {{notes}} notes).
backup.importPreferencesWarning: Workspace data was restored, but browser storage rejected one or more preference updates. Review your local settings.
backup.exportError: Failed to export the workspace backup.
backup.exportTooLarge: The backup exceeds the 50 MiB restore limit and was not downloaded.
backup.invalidFormat: Invalid backup format. Expected an ALTERA schemaVersion: 3 JSON file.
backup.readError: Could not read the backup file.
backup.importError: Failed to restore the workspace from the backup file.

integrity.title: Database Integrity
integrity.description: Run a read-only scan for broken references between projects, tasks, sessions, notes, and resources. No records will be changed.
integrity.failed: The integrity scan failed. Your data was not modified.

reset.title: Reset & Demo Data
